create.name: Bodhidharma Zendo
create.bio:
Bodhidharma Zendo is a Rinzai Zen association based in Vienna, with its city zendo on the Fleischmarkt in the old town, affiliated groups in Graz, Klagenfurt and near Salzburg, and a mountain retreat centre on the Hohe Wand in Lower Austria, now called Hyakujōgan Zendo. It grew out of a small sitting group in 1979, when the Viennese painter and Zen priest Seiun Genro Koudela returned from years of monastic training in the United States under the Japanese teacher Kyozan Joshu Sasaki; Genro led it until his death in 2010. Since 2012 its teacher and abbot has been Seigaku Kigen Oshō (William Ekeson), an American Rinzai priest who trained for nine years at Mount Baldy Zen Center. The association publishes its own statement acknowledging the harm caused by Sasaki's sexual misconduct and follows a code of conduct with an ethics council.

Newcomers start with a free introductory talk and instruction evening, held several times a year, or a paid introductory class, after which they can sit with the group for a month before joining as members. Zazen runs on weekday evenings and early mornings in Vienna, and the abbot leads weekend zazenkai and week-long sesshin at the mountain zendo, with lighter versions suited to beginners.

courses.title: Zen-Einführungskurs
courses.description: A Thursday-evening class in Vienna that teaches the forms of Zen practice in detail: sitting, walking meditation, chanting and the tea ceremony. Booking by email is needed, and attending opens a free month of sitting with the group.

courses.title: Rohatsu Go-Sesshin
courses.description: A five-day Rinzai retreat at the Hyakujōgan Zendo on the Hohe Wand, marking the Buddha's awakening, with zazen, walking meditation, chanting, daily talks and one-to-one meetings with Abbot Kigen Oshō. Previous Zen experience is required.

courses.title: Sesshins und Zazenkais
courses.description: Weekend and week-long Rinzai retreats at the mountain zendo, led by the abbot, with sitting and walking meditation, chanting, talks, interviews, formal meals and work practice. Lighter versions with shorter sits and later rising suit beginners.

courses.title: Vereinsmitgliedschaft
courses.description: Membership of the association that runs the zendo, which gives access to all regular zazen in the Vienna city zendo and reduced rates for retreats. Reduced or waived fees can be arranged.
